figurative_meaning_en: To exploit someone completely, taking everything away
example_sentences_in_bangla: সেই ব্যবসায়ী তার কর্মচারীদের রক্তশোষণ করে লাভবান হচ্ছে।
দরিদ্র কৃষকেরা মহাজনের রক্তশোষণে কাতর হয়ে পড়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: That businessman is exploiting his employees to make profits.
The poor farmers are suffering from the moneylender's bloodsucking practices.
history: Refers to the exploitative practices of moneylenders (mahajans) towards debtors (khata) in traditional rural Bengali society, often linked to feudal and colonial-era debt cycles.
note: The idiom vividly captures the imagery of vampiric exploitation in Bengali folklore and literature.
